notes.title: Early Access Launch Date
notes.content:
Hey everyone!

I am excited to announce that Shadow Eclipse is entering early access on 3/23/2024!

After releasing [b]20 [/b]patches to the Shadow Eclipse Playtest and Demo over the past two-ish years of solo development, I feel Shadow Eclipse is in a state where it will benefit greatly from early access.

My main goal is that the early access process will bring stronger feedback, criticism, and engagement from interested players during the rest of development. Feedback from playtesters has already immensely shaped the game - THANK YOU. 

I expect there to be about 2 more years of development work at my current pace before Shadow Eclipse will be fully released. For my tentative roadmap I will be focusing on: spell upgrades and build diversity,  challenging boss fights, enemy variety especially in the mid and late game stages, level diversity, and lastly overall story and metagame content.

For players who do not want to join early access, I am committed to continuously releasing new versions of the free demo. The demo will contain up-to-date early game content and patches, but limit each run to level 5 after the duo boss fight.

[previewyoutube=MBEub9NTRcw;full][/previewyoutube]

Cheers!
-Shadow Eclipse team aka Brian

notes.title: Patch 14. Released 02/22/2023
notes.content:
[b]New Features:[/b]
[list]
[*] Upon death, you turn into a spectating ghost while there is at least 1 other player alive.
[*] Doors locked until room mobs are defeated now show a visual hint when the player is nearby.
[/list]

[b]Changes:[/b]
[list]
[*] Enemies now have colliders and you can no longer walk directly through them.
[*] Player names now default to a random fantasy name.
[*] Game now starts in fullscreen when launched.
[/list]

[b]Bug Fixes:[/b]
[list]
[*] The upgrade existing spells menu now only shows upgrades for spells your player has learned.
[*] Removed LightStone from possible equipment pickups, now that it is a consumable item pickup to avoid duplicate items in the loadout.
[*] Player action input is now blocked while focusing in a text input field.
[*] Spell exhaust is reset on all clients after leaving the start room instead of just the host.
[*] Fixed bug where Light Stone ability would stay lit longer on clients than the host.
[*] Fixed other misc multiplayer visual bugs.
[/list]
